aiResearchSummary.text: Heimdal is researching carbon capture method and system technologies focused on extracting carbon from sea water. The abstract describes methods, systems, and apparatus that use a reverse osmosis chamber to separate fresh water and brine, then route the brine to an electrolyzer where current is applied to enable carbon capture. Overall, Heimdal is developing sea water based carbon capture processes and integrated system architectures.
